changes: Night-only rolling stack; daytime single source with fixed transfer.
Nearest even proportional size uses the full 1280 bound on rectangular cameras.
Positive sub-frame sunrise window support, independent of capture exposure.
boundary: Genuine five-minute advancing VirtualSky inputs. Same production boundary and quotas as PRODUCTION.md. One timed trial per case; no full-hour/full-day/capture soak claim. Earlier unmodified night measurements remain in production-results.json.
